messages:
rachel_sales: Heads-up team-- NovaCardiology (enterprise) just signaled intent for a 12-mo commit. They quoted traffic ~5.2M tokens/day and asked for reserved GPUs, a burst escrow, monthly spend cap, and HIPAA/SOC2 artifacts. Need a conservative + optimistic capacity sketch + commercial construct today. @omar_presales @sam_eng

omar_presales: They attached a sample day: baseline ~45 rps, morning sync spike ~4x for 15m, evening plateau ~1.5x for 40m, occasional short microbursts. Typical generation median ~100 tokens, p95 ~260. They require AZ spread, canary rollout, and BYOK KMS.

sam_eng: Quick estimate: tokens/day 5,200,000 -> requests/day ≈ 52k if median=100 (avg ~0.6 req/sec). Peak rps = 45 * 4 = 180 rps. Peak token throughput (p95) = 180 * 260 = 46,800 tokens/sec.

sam_eng: GPU throughput assumptions: conservative ~9-10k tokens/sec (longer context penalties), optimistic ~13k tokens/sec (shorter average). Using 10k => gpus_needed = ceil(46800 / 10000) = 5. Using 13k => 4. Recommend reserved commit = 6 GPUs (three prod + one per-AZ buffer + 1 runway) actually that phrasing sounds odd; better: reserve 6 GPUs to cover production + AZ buffer; provision a burst escrow of 3 GPUs for short spikes or cross-AZ recovery. If client accepts quantized 8-bit variants we can drop reserved to 4-5 GPUs but must sign off on quality tradeoffs.

dina_sre: Autoscale + preheat recommendations: min_instances=3 (keep healthy KV cache), scale_target_util=70%, scale_step=1 GPU, cooldown=90s, max_instances=9, burst_pool=3, prewarm_seconds=600. Canary rollout: 3% for 10m -> 15% for 20m -> 40% for 20m -> 100%; forced rollback if tail_latency > 2x SLO or error_rate > 1.2% during any canary window.

dina_sre: KV warmup job: run representative 30-prompt set at 2 rps per instance for 10 minutes starting 12 minutes before morning peak. Example cron: `0 7 * * 1-5 /opt/presales/preheat.sh --set=novacard-sample --rps=2 --duration=600`. Also snapshot KV after major rollouts. Health checks to surface: kv_hit_rate, tail_latency_ms (p99), gpu_util_pct, queue_depth.

sam_eng: Small calc snippet I'll put in the doc:
```
peak_rps = 45 * 4  # = 180
peak_tokens_sec = peak_rps * 260  # = 46800
gpu_tps_conservative = 10000
gpus_needed = math.ceil(46800 / gpu_tps_conservative)  # = 5
reserve_recommendation = 6
burst_pool = 3
```

ben_fin: Commercial proposal idea: Offer two commitment tiers: CoreReserve = 6 GPUs committed monthly + burst escrow (3 GPU-hours/day) + 18% discount for 12-mo. CoreReserve+ = 8 GPUs commit + 6 GPU-hours/day burst + 24% discount + premium SLA. For monthly cap: set a firm spend cap tied to committed capacity + an explicit overage rate for burst consumption; allow unused burst hours to rollover up to a monthly cap. Add quarterly review to adjust runway.

omar_presales: Callout: if they expect >30% growth or longer outputs (>350 tokens), we should either increase reserved buffers or add auto-scaling headroom clauses to contract. Quantization delta: 8-bit reduces GPU needs ~30-45% in practice but requires validation on their prompt set.

kira_legal: For the security questionnaire items: confirm SOC2 + ISO27001 attachments, HIPAA BAAs available, BYOK/KMS flow documented, data residency EU/US (they requested EU for some patients), and key rotation policy: support for customer-managed keys with 90-day rotation recommended. I'll draft short answers; need Dina to confirm technical steps for VPC peering and private control plane.

infra_bot: presales/docs/novacard/capacity_calc_draft.pdf uploaded by sam_eng at 1765432200

dina_sre: Runbook excerpt (for the presales pack): when p99 latency > 2x SLO for 3m OR queue_depth > 4000: 1) enable burst pool, 2) throttle non-critical routes (batch exports), 3) if no recovery in 5m, redirect 30% traffic to secondary region and notify oncall. Add postmortem template and CPU/GPU flame graphs.

sam_eng: I'll include short notes on kernel selection and quantization sensitivity: some models show >10% quality drop on abstractive summarization with 8-bit; flag for QA signoff.

rachel_sales: Action items: 1) Sam - produce 1p capacity calc + two scenarios (conservative/optimistic) + one-paragraph quantization risk by COB. 2) Omar - draft commercial term language for cap, rollover, burst escrow, and discount tiers. 3) Dina - autoscale JSON, preheat snippet, runbook excerpt + SOC2/HIPAA attachment checklist. 4) Kira - start security questionnaire answers and BAA draft. Target: ship consolidated presales package to NovaCardio by tomorrow AM.

ben_fin: I'll draft the invoice sketch with committed seat and burst line items so legal can review pricing language.

rachel_sales: Thanks all. Ping if any numbers change; priority is to be conservative for enterprise legal. We'll reconvene after docs are uploaded. :thumbsup:
